subject: Intermittent latency spikes — request for temporary SLA adjustment & escalation coverage
messages:
From: Aaron Hughes <aaron.hughes@clearchip.co>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@clearchip.co
Date: 2026-10-11T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: production latency spikes this weekend

Karthik —

We saw repeated latency spikes across several inference routes overnight (50–200ms baseline -> 600–900ms bursts) that caused two P1 incidents for our checkout flow. The spikes started around 02:30 PDT and recurred sporadically until ~05:15. Attached are the request-timing histograms and traces from our side.

This has triggered our internal incident cadence; our billing and ops teams are asking whether Redwood can provide a temporary SLA concession for response-time SLOs while you investigate. Specifically: can you approve a temporary adjustment to P1 response objectives (allowing 2 additional minutes of median tail for the next 72 hours) and provide an explicit escalation path and on-call coverage plan?

We need something we can present to our compliance committee later today. Please advise ASAP — we have a post-mortem call scheduled at 11:00 PDT.

Thanks,
Aaron
Head of Platform Engineering, ClearChip

--
Attachments: latency_graphs_20261010.png (image/png)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Aaron Hughes <aaron.hughes@clearchip.co>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent latency spikes — request for temporary SLA adjustment & escalation coverage

Aaron — thanks for the data and heads up. We're actively tracing this. Initial notes: the spikes correlate with a cloud provider network flapping event in the us-west-2 fab between 02:15–05:30. Our routing and autoscaler reacted but some hot-shard KV cache misses increased token latency for a subset of routes.

Short-term proposal (we can formalize with legal if you approve):
- Temporary SLA adjustment: allow a 120s tail buffer for affected P1 endpoints over a 72-hour window (2026-10-11T09:00 to 2026-10-14T09:00 PDT).
- Escalation: named on-call escalation sequence (SRE -> Ops Lead -> Head of Support) with guaranteed 30-minute acknowledgements for P1s during the window.
- On-call coverage: we will add an extra night-shift swing from our dedicated US pool (Vivek will confirm staffing).

I've looped in Monica (support lead), Ben (account owner), and Laura (CS) so we can confirm impact and get the temporary concession documented.

I'll follow up with Vivek on the operational steps.

—Karthik
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent latency spikes — request for temporary SLA adjustment & escalation coverage

Karthik / team — I support the temporary window but want to be explicit on the operational commitments we make back to ClearChip. Suggested wording for customer-facing note: 

"Redwood will provision enhanced on-call coverage and an operational escalation path for P1 incidents affecting ClearChip between 2026-10-11T09:00 and 2026-10-14T09:00 PDT. During this period Redwood will accept a temporary P1 response objective deviation of +120 seconds for affected endpoints while we deploy mitigations; Redwood will provide hourly incident status updates until the issue is resolved."

Also adding the attachments we referenced to the draft playbook and a short mitigation checklist. Can legal expedite a one-paragraph SLA amendment template?

—Monica
Head of Support Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: support_playbook_draft.pdf (application/pdf)
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent latency spikes — request for temporary SLA adjustment & escalation coverage

Agree we should approve this concession — commercial note: ClearChip is in a committed Dedicated contract (Q3 reserved capacity). Approving a temporary SLA adjustment reduces churn risk and avoids early-escalation to procurement. I propose we also offer a one-time 10% credit on token usage for the 72-hour window as a gesture; check margin with finance if needed.

Laura — can you confirm whether ClearChip needs an updated SOC/incident note for their compliance committee?

—Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent latency spikes — request for temporary SLA adjustment & escalation coverage

Operational update: we can stand up an extra on-call shift tonight (10/11) and tomorrow night from the Dedicated pool. Steps I'm taking now:
1) Fail over routing for critical routes to secondary region (us-east-1) for traffic originating from ClearChip's primary IP blocks; will begin test cutover at 12:00 PDT and move traffic if traces show improvement.
2) Increase KV cache redundancy and warm caches for the affected routes — expected improvement in 20–40 minutes after warm-up.
3) SRE postmortem ticket created: INF-4821 (see link).

If routing cutover resolves the tail, we will roll back within 2 hours. If not, we'll maintain the temporary SLA allowance and provide hourly updates.

—Vivek
Head of Production Engineering
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Aaron Hughes <aaron.hughes@clearchip.co>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Bcc: legal@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-12T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent latency spikes — temporary SLA adjustment and coverage confirmation

Aaron — following ops validation and leadership approval, Redwood will proceed with the temporary SLA adjustment and enhanced on-call coverage as outlined below:

- Window: 2026-10-11T09:00 to 2026-10-14T09:00 PDT
- Adjustment: +120s tail allowance for P1 endpoints if latency is traceable to provider-side flapping or net degradation during the window
- On-call & Escalation: additional night-shift coverage staffed; P1 acknowledgement target 30 minutes; Ops Lead escalation to Head of Support / Head of Production within 60 minutes if unresolved
- Customer updates: hourly incident status while the event is active; a consolidated post-mortem within 5 business days
- Compensation: Redwood account team to follow up on a one-time usage credit proposal

Please reply to this thread to confirm you have what you need for your compliance committee. We'll also circulate a one-paragraph amendment for signature.

Appreciate your patience while we fix this.

—Karthik
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
